Venison works best with a white pizza. So the first thing to do (after setting the oven to 425°F for preheating) is to prepare the dough in the usual way. Get it stretched over the pan, spread olive oil over it, and sprinkle with basil, black pepper, and rosemary. Grate your mozzarella cheese (use a little more than you think you need, because this is a white pizza; white pizza is supposed to be very cheesy) and sprinkle it liberally with more rosemary. Now take some ground venison (I'd say about a quarter pound for a standard 12" pie), break it up, add half a finely-chopped red onion and a couple finely-chopped cloves of garlic, and sautée the whole mess in your cast-iron frying pan (you do have one of those, right?) until the meat is just starting to brown. Remove from heat and evenly broadcast the meat-onion-garlic mixture over the pie. By this point the oven should have come up to temperature. In goes the pie for about 10-12 minutes.
